movelist.name: Discharge
movelist.effect: Discharge Paralyzes all legal targets on 15+.

movelist.name: Thunder Punch
movelist.effect: Thunder Punch Paralyzes the target on 19+.

movelist.name: Electro Ball
movelist.effect: The user adds their Speed Stat, including Combat Stages, in addition to their Special Attack when determining the damage dealt by Electro Ball. The Defender in turn subtracts both their Special Defense and Speed Stats from the damage dealt before applying Type Effectiveness.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Grass-Type attacks. If the user is hit by a Grass-Type attack, they gain +1 CS in their choice of Attack or Special Attack. Defensive.

abilities.name: Plus
abilities.trigger: An ally within 10m has Combat Stages raised
abilities.effect: The target gains an additional Combat Stage in one stat raised by the triggering effect.
